How it works
  1. Find the existing profile or request an accurately labeled create-profile path.
  2. Correct public facts for free and preserve the real physical city or service area.
  3. Use Franklin Assistant or the free Growth Planner to choose a useful local goal.
  4. Preview richer member value and decide whether Community Membership fits.

Richer local presence

Once Franklin confirms you represent the profile, manage member-provided descriptions, services, images, contact routes, accessibility and language information.

Community participation

Use offers, events and community tools where supported. Member status never equals endorsement.

Growth Desk planning

Use practical English, Spanish or bilingual tools to plan local outreach and community participation.
